description: Pillars, terraced mesas ringed by badwater channels with only seep-fed clean water: the industry is spread over the benches of the central pillars, the two Deep Ore Sources lie on the pillars north and south-west of the start, the two Deep Ore Veins on the far south-east and north-west pillars, and the five Human Record Caches around two Archive Excavation sites on the northern and south-eastern pillars.

unmet.reason: The only clean water within route 60 of the start is the pond of the seep at (103, 93) (strength 1); within 4 cells of it lie 168 dry cells, but 77 of them are forest, leaving 91 free cells (min 150). Every other clean water body is a seep pond on another pillar beyond the badwater channels.
The pillar tops are terraced: no dry, flat 20x15 footprint exists at any level; the largest flat dry rectangle at least 15 cells deep is 13x15 and the largest square is 13x13.

No source-fed water has any natural bed drop: the four seep ponds each lie on one bed level (11, 12, 13, 13) and the badwater channel network fed by the eight badwater sources lies entirely on level 0.

Thirteen buildings need a flat footprint of at least 12x9 or 11x10 (launch pad, four 12x11 plants, Mission Control, Steel Mill, Deep Processor, Cryogenic Tank Farm, Hospital, Electrolysis Plant, two Deep Mines), but the terraced pillar tops hold only 5 disjoint dry flat 12x11 footprints, 9 of 12x10 and 12 of 11x10 (greedy count, ruin columns excluded); greedy packing and about 70 ruin-and-recreate searches always left two of them without a site. The Cryogenic Tank Farm (pipe-fed fuel storage) is one of the two left out.

Same footprint shortage as the Cryogenic Tank Farm: only 5 disjoint dry flat 12x11, 9 of 12x10 and 12 of 11x10 footprints exist for the thirteen buildings that need at least 12x9 or 11x10, and every packing search left two without a site; the 12x9 Hospital is the second one left out.
